newsitem.title: USA: Service Corp says board oks Loewen purchase.
newsitem.headline: Service Corp says board oks Loewen purchase.

text.p: Service Corporation International said on Wednesday its board of directors ratified its proposed acquisition of The Loewen Group Inc in a stock swap that valued Loewen at $43 per share.

"Our board is enthusiastic about this transaction and firmly believes that a combination of our businesses as we proposed yesterday is in the best interests of Loewen's and SCI's stockholders," Service Corporation President and Chief Operating Officer William Heiligbrodt said in a statement.
Service Corporation proposed the acquisition on Tuesday in a letter to Loewen Group Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Raymond Loewen, it said.
The unsolicited bid was valued at US$2.5 billion.
